sensors.name: right light sensor (the light from above)

control_flow: driveInTheDark: if the right light sensor reads more than 75 %, drive forward at 30 % without end; else call stopAtWall.
stopAtWall: if an obstacle is ahead, stop; else call followLine.
followLine: if the line tracker sees black, curve left; else curve right.

likely_intent.description: Follow the black line, drive straight through a dark tunnel without touching its walls, and follow the line again after the tunnel.

decision_points.condition: the right light sensor reads more than 75 % (bright, in the open)

branches.outcome: bright: the robot drives straight forward at 30 % without end
dim (in a tunnel): it goes on to check the front obstacle sensor

decision_points.condition: an obstacle is less than 3 cm in front of the front sensor

branches.reason: In the dark the only thing in front can be a tunnel wall the robot turns into; it is not sure the front sensor sees it before the robot touches it.
branches.outcome: something is ahead: the robot stops
nothing ahead: it goes on to follow the line
black under the line tracker: it curves left

scenarios.coded_response: In the dark it stops when something is in front, otherwise it follows the line: with no line it curves right for ever, turns into a tunnel wall and stops there. In the light it drives straight forward again instead of following the line.

scenarios.coded_response: In the dark it follows the line: it curves left on black and right on white, again and again.

uncertainties: You said the robot should follow the line in the light and drive straight in the dark, but your program does the opposite: straight in the light (above 75 %) and line-following in the dark.
In the dark the only thing in front can be a tunnel wall the robot turns into; whether the front sensor sees it before the robot touches it is not sure.
You said the tunnel has no line; with a line in it the program follows it there, which you didn't ask for.
You didn't say where the line ends or what the robot should do at a wall in the dark.
After the tunnel a robot that does what you said may come out a little to one side of the line and miss it, so following the line again after the tunnel is hard to test.
